prompt.generated_prompt_string: Create a photorealistic warm indoor medium close-up of an adult woman with tan skin and voluminous curly brown hair falling over her right shoulder. She has a small black bindi, winged eyeliner, glossy lips, and a playful pursed-lip expression. She leans forward slightly with her head tilted toward camera. She wears a fitted silver-and-gold metallic chainmail halter top with a draped cowl neckline and long fringe, paired with a dark-green skirt or trousers. Frame from eye level to a slight high angle with the face and metallic halter as the focal points. Use warm front-and-side ambient light around 3000K, soft warm shadows, and reflective highlights across the metal mesh. Keep a softly blurred warm interior, medium contrast, natural skin texture, and a playful moody fashion-editorial atmosphere.
